speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Many nursing homes are also run by voluntary welfare organisations and may tap on charitable donations to provide further financial support to their residents.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I think the last group of people are the people who need this the most.

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: There is also the Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme, which provides support for severely disabled Pioneers through a cash payout of $100 per month for life.

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: So, these and other schemes remain available and, certainly, on a case-by-case basis, where the most vulnerable class of persons who are severely disabled, needs assistance, the Ministry will look into those.
